trade-news.title: Trade News 模块（News/Opinion/Research + Announcement + 详情分享 + URL 重定向 + 埋点）
trade-news.summary: Trade 页 News 业务完整实现：单端点 biz/v1/asset/intelligence 拉取 3 资产 × 多子 tab 内容；PostDetailDialog 单文件双内容组件 + isShareView 内嵌分享；shareURLAction DU switch 三道去重接收侧消费；html2canvas 海报截图 + 5 渠道分享；asset_detail_click + feeds_share_click 2 个埋点全覆盖

coreLogic: useNewsList({seoName, infoType, isOfficial?}) → GET biz/v1/asset/intelligence with cursor (lastSortValues/currentField) [src/features/news/containers/useNewsList.ts:23-72]
useStockAnnouncement({seoName, announcementType}) → same endpoint with infoType=announcement, pageNum 翻页 [src/features/news/containers/useStockAnnouncement.ts:21-60]
openPostDetailDialog({post, ticker?, type?}) → isMobileScreen() ? openDrawer : openModal，单文件双内容组件 [src/features/news/components/PostDetailDialog.tsx:439-485]
useNewsShare(post, posterRef) → {joinUrl, detailRow, shareRail}，6 渠道分发（X/Telegram/Copy Link/Copy Poster/Download Poster/Source）[src/features/news/containers/useNewsShare.ts:39-128]
useShareURLActionConsumer() → DU + switch，case 'feeds' → fetchNewsPostById + openPostDetailDialog，三道去重 [src/features/shareURLAction/containers/useShareURLActionConsumer.ts:130-147]
keyComponents: NewsPanel — PC/Mobile News 入口，4 props 受控（symbolInfo/activeNewsTab/marketType/isOfficial）[features/news/components/index.tsx:22-48]
NewsTable + NewsTableRow + NewsCard + AnnouncementList — 列表渲染，PC 行 vs Mobile 卡片自动切换 [features/news/components/]
PostDetailDialog — 详情弹窗 + 内嵌 isShareView，含 MobilePostDetailContent (:57) 和 PcPostDetailContent (:228)
DetailShareRow + ShareActions — 分享渠道按钮，PC 顶部 3 个 + 分享视图 5 个 [shared/components/features/ShareActions/]
CoinInfoTabs — 7 项 tab union (chart/intro/news/opinion/research/announcement/data)，按 marketType 决定 data 显示 [features/trade/components/CoinInfoTabs/index.tsx:11-18]
pitfalls: PostDetailDialog.tsx:481 PC 宽度数学不一致 (740 vs 720 vs 684)
useShareURLActionConsumer.ts:50 过期 TODO 注释与实际实现矛盾
SectorChip / SourceAvatar 死文件（grep 0 引用）
spot.json 含 8 个旧 NewsShareDialog 时代死 i18n key
Announcement type 类型 0|1|2 但实测仅 0|1
